Frontend Playwright e2e PASS: signup -> dashboard with 10,000 SC -> click AAPL -> /kids/analyze/AAPL renders real kid_view ('Apple flashes mixed signals: strong momentum meets a cautionary candlestick pattern.' + kid_explanation + 'How sure is the AI?' panel) -> Buy 1 AAPL -> balance 10,000 -> 9,723.17 SC (exact 10000-276.83) -> /kids/portfolio shows AAPL 1sh avg $276.83 P&L 0.00% -> Logout clears sai_kid_token and redirects to /kids/login -> route guard kicks logged-out users from /kids/dashboard back to /kids/login. Zero console errors. No mocks - all integrations live (Mongo, Anthropic/Gemini via Emergent LLM Key).

critical_code_review_comments: kids_portfolio.py: BUY trade uses sequential 'inc balance' then 'insert trade' with manual rollback in except. Mongo replica-set is available - consider wrapping in a session.start_transaction() for true atomicity. Edge case: if process is killed between $inc and insert, balance is permanently desynced. Low-prob but worth a TODO.

kids_portfolio.py:_held_qty does a separate aggregate per SELL preflight, then the position aggregate runs again in /portfolio. For V1-beta volume this is fine but if trades scale up consider denormalising holdings.
kids_auth.py uses re.match for birthdate format then date.fromisoformat - the regex check is technically redundant since fromisoformat already validates YYYY-MM-DD. Minor cleanup.

Frontend: KidsAnalyzePage successfully shows the kid_view, but did_you_know and reflection_question fields aren't visible above the fold in initial viewport - users may miss them. Consider giving these their own labelled card with data-testid='kid-did-you-know' and data-testid='kid-reflection' for both UX clarity and test stability.
